Work in {project_root} on {date}. V721 records eight executed producers, two pre-gate receipts and four absent primaries. Exp8361 qualified H1=-0.00390625 and H2=0 on exposed development data. TASK:
Test a separately versioned action certificate without a sigmoid proof. Deliver results/experiment_8381_v722_logit_policy_certificate.json. Create thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8381_v722_logit_policy_certificate.py. Keep primitive evidence in results/raw/experiment_8381_v722_logit_policy_certificate/. Future producer paths are dependencies, not existing inputs.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Print a flushed start line. Authenticate this task and each input hash. Check private disk-backed scratch, tool availability, memory and time budgets. Put missing external inputs in gate_check_summary. Never fabricate missing observations.
2. Print a flushed progress line at every phase boundary and before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess. Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Keep every output gap below 600 seconds, including synthesis. Use unbuffered output and bounded child deadlines within the 4800-second cap. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. Never issue one huge file-writing call or pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add the relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Preserve old assertions and validation thresholds. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Place runners in scripts/experiments/ and throwaway probes in /tmp. Freeze validation commands before measurement. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml.
4. Declare no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current LLM calls. Use aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts for readers, verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates for numeric heads, or the explicitly named no-LLM ARC runtime substrate. Small numeric training is not an LLM load.
5. Create an isolated numerical prototype named dyadic_logit_v1. Its mathematical action rule compares the exact rational spline logit divided by the exact binary64 temperature against +/-L, where L is the exact dyadic number 0x1.193ea7aad030bp+0. Equality escalates. This is a new policy definition; it is not universally equivalent to the old SciPy probability rule.
6. Use the frozen head, original binary64 knot values interpreted as exact rationals and65-point int16 tables. Reuse the rational spline remainder derivation but audit table construction, global arithmetic and interval rounding independently. Build conservative logit intervals. A fast action requires the entire interval to lie in one new-policy region. Otherwise evaluate the exact rational reference. No empirical expit allowance enters the certificate.
7. Use4096 seeded label-free vectors, every knot, exact dyadic threshold witnesses and nextafter neighbors. Compare certified fast actions with an independent rational polynomial evaluator. Separately report every action difference from the old SciPy policy without changing its historical results. Require zero certified escapes and zero new-policy action disagreements. Report fast coverage; >=.5 on the random panel is useful_score, not a reason to relax safety.
8. Test refreshed coefficients from the existing delayed trajectory, mismatched table/head versions, saturation, under-bounds and altered rounding assumptions. Include a deliberately incorrect bound that the checker rejects. Confidence probabilities and Brier retain empirical scope; action certification cannot certify semantic truth or calibrated confidence.
9. Run private E2E-018 and all current threshold-guard consumers. Keep the prototype default-off, with no gate into direct service or ARC and no production-policy migration. Write docs/research-notes/v722-logit-policy-certificate.md with exact arithmetic assumptions and migration differences. Failure is an informative isolated result, not a milestone-wide block.
10. Run relevant unit and consumer tests. Run scoped Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private disk-backed scratch. Run the applicable private E2E checks named above. Record commands, exits, durations and log hashes. Keep global repository health separate.
11. Cold-replay primitive rows in a fresh process. Exercise valid, missing-input, deliberate-error and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Run unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep every finding. Only the existing typed consumer may resolve independently recomputed informational findings. Unknown, warning and critical findings block readiness. Do not modify validators or exemptions. Publish checked terminal bytes atomically. Use disqualified for owned validation failure and blocked for unchanged external absence; partial is only retryable unfinished owned work. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind results to this exact invocation and task authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Use a complete_ terminal verdict. The closed class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. External absence is blocked, never partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: For every blocked_* or complete_blocked_* verdict, name the check, upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected value and observed value. Distinguish absent from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Distinguish current calls from cached observations and small numeric heads.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Preserve every intended unit and arm with its metric and missing reason. Repeated timings are not independent examples.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle-checked positives use circular_positive. Exposed, constructed and feasibility work keeps both generalization scores zero.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Successful execution cannot imply scientific benefit.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Every measurement must be reproducible from sealed operands.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported fields with producer hashes. Explain every added result field.
action_certificate_ready_score, useful_score, new_policy_id, exact_threshold, proof_assumptions: principle: Certify only the explicitly changed mathematical action contract.
interval_escape_count, action_mismatch_count, original_policy_difference_rows, fast_path_fraction: principle: Preserve old-policy differences and require independent numerical evidence.
production_migration_authorized, calibrated_confidence_certified: principle: Both remain false; this prototype grants no semantic or deployment claim.
